your father is an influential, rich businessman with questionable morals, reason why your family had a long list of enemies.
You, being your father’s beloved daughter, couldn’t stay without any protection, which is why he had hired Leon to stay with you at all times.

that night your father had organized a dinner with a few other influential men in his circle, and you were forced to take part in it. so there you were, sitting in a table full of people as your bodyguard stood diligently behind your seat, alert of your surroundings.
